test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 20 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the series were to be continued? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23c0ae9e34c8ba65d2bdb3a6b0379258f0c9719676cfda34ff5979ab178a548d.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

From figure 1 to 2, and figure 3 to 4:

All top 3 letters are shifting their position in a clockwise direction.

Middle, bottom-right and middle-bottom letters are shifting their position in an anticlockwise direction.

From figure 2 to 3, and figure 4 to 5:

All 4 corner letters are shifting their position in an anticlockwise direction.

Middle and top-left letters are interchanging their position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e9b2d3a2ec195cd3385e33596a45f69a967ffdb7e9275af8c2312dae8421a97.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
